summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: This package is published as a Babel preset but ships a preinstall script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a bundled math_init.js file (~727 KB, single-line obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` payload with rotated string tables). setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x24db8d`) and inlined string-key objects to obscure control flow. The preinstall hook runs automatically on `npm install`. A Babel preset has no functional need for an alternate language runtime or a 727 KB obfuscated bundle; the shipped main entry (index.js) is an unrelated 30-line Babel preset factory, and the README is a two-line stub. The alternate-runtime execution path (Bun rather than Node) evades Node-focused instrumentation, and the payload contents are not inspectable in source form. Behavior is consistent with either an account/token compromise of the @ornikar scope or an impersonating release of the internal preset.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
